subject: math
description: Determine when lines must be parallel or perpendicular using direction, angle relationships, and right-angle intersections.
learningObjectives: Recognize visual conditions that suggest lines have the same direction or meet at right angles
Use corresponding and alternate interior angle relationships to decide whether two lines are parallel
Use same-side interior angle relationships to test for parallel lines
Identify perpendicular lines from right-angle intersections
Justify whether lines must be parallel, perpendicular, both impossible, or not enough information
prerequisites: Name angles from diagrams using correct notation
Identify corresponding, alternate interior, and same-side interior angles
Recognize vertical angles, linear pairs, and supplementary angles
Understand that perpendicular lines form right angles
Solve simple angle equations involving 90 and 180
